{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping missing values
n_penguins_clean = len(penguins_clean)

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Print the result and the count
print(f'Number of penguins after dropping missing body mass: {n_penguins_clean}')
print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
